description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing audio ports and their configurations within Android's audio policy framework, including PolicyAudioPort and PolicyAudioPortConfig classes.

classes.name: PolicyAudioPort
classes.description: Abstract class representing an audio port with methods for profile matching, attachment, and route management.

classes.name: PolicyAudioPortConfig
classes.description: Interface for audio port configuration, providing access to associated PolicyAudioPort and validation methods.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the tag name of the audio port.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another PolicyAudioPort has the same tag name.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches the port to a hardware module.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the port from its hardware module.

methods.name: checkExactAudioProfile
methods.description: Checks if a given audio port configuration matches exactly.

methods.name: pickAudioProfile
methods.description: Selects an appropriate audio profile based on parameters.

methods.name: hasSameHwModuleAs
methods.description: Checks if another port configuration shares the same hardware module.
